> Roles follow MAINTAINERS.md; readiness evidence follows governance/readiness.json rules.
> GitHub permissions do not by themselves establish a role, and self-authored or
> Cordum-controlled claims do not count as independent evidence.

## Type

- [ ] Public adopter evidence
- [ ] Independent implementation evidence

- **Consent to be listed:** (link)
